images.prompt: An ornate gold-leaf Egyptian-revival cartouche framing a stylized cheesecake wedge, on a full-bleed deep bronze field, embossed art-deco luxury styling, fine engraved hairlines, lotus and papyrus motifs in the cartouche border, warm metallic gold on dark bronze. Full-bleed square: the deep bronze background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: THE CHEESECAKE MANUFACTORY. Set that wordmark in an elegant engraved art-deco serif beneath the cartouche on exactly two lines: line one reads THE CHEESECAKE, line two reads MANUFACTORY. Critical correction: a previous attempt wrongly repeated the word CHEESECAKE on a duplicate third line. The word CHEESECAKE must appear exactly once in the whole image. Exactly three words total, two lines total, no duplicated line, no extra line of type, no subtitle, no tagline.

Cinematic architectural interior photography. The interior of a cavernous faux-Egyptian revival restaurant: towering marble columns with gold-leaf capitals, hanging amber glass lamps, endless booth seating receding into darkness, a coffered ceiling lost in shadow, one impossibly large dessert on a distant table catching a single pool of light. Dim amber restaurant lighting, warm golden pools of light, deep mahogany shadows, opulent and slightly oppressive. Camera: 24mm wide angle, f/4, deep perspective down the center aisle, subtle haze in the air. Deadpan hyperreal cinematic realism, completely deserted. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
